text: {"name":"util_update_state","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Uses the global state record when its control word is nonzero, stores the supplied value at byte offset 20 from the selected entry, and returns that entry; otherwise it delegates to bt_config_check.","subsystem":"util","var_renames":{"a1":"byte_offset","a2":"state_value","result":"state_entry"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":4,"meaning":"Control word checked to select the local state-record path."},{"offset":20,"meaning":"Byte written with the supplied state value relative to the selected entry."}]}
